text:
deploybot: Promotion paused for release v1.12.0 -> prod (change window 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC). Env parity check failed: prod KMS alias `alias/user-secrets` -> v3, canary -> v2. Smoke tests failing. Pausing promotion. Runbook: https://our-runbooks/keystore-rotation
maya: noted. is this the rotation that ran ~17:40?
kyle: yes, ops rotated alias in prod at 17:39. canary still points to old alias; app auth failing during model load.
sre-jordan: smoke test logs: `auth: failed to fetch key: alias/user-secrets (NotFound)`; stacktrace shows model-sidecar failing to initialize.
nina: what's the rollback plan? release pinned to image sha: `abc123def`, we could rollback to previous release but that loses the fixes in v1.12.0.
maya: alternative is to align canary keystore to prod alias so smoke tests pass, then promote. but that requires a quick keystore update in canary.
sam: change window ends in ~50m. ops - can you do an emergency parity update in canary? what's the blast radius?
ops-lydia: Emergency update ok. Affects `inference-runtime` and `api-gateway` services in canary - each restart ~10s. Cache warmup ~1-2min. Minimal SLO impact. Will need `kms:UpdateAlias` permission and vault change.
kyle: also callout: dedicated tenants might have legacy keystore paths; this check only validated app alias, not tenant-level mappings.
releasebot: Note added to release: "DO NOT PROMOTE until keystore alias parity confirmed". Release notes link: https://releases/1.12.0
nina: prefer updating canary now and re-run smoke tests. @ops-lydia please proceed.
ops-lydia: starting canary alias update now (rolling). posting logs...
ops-lydia: update complete. canary services restarted. running smoke tests.
deploybot: Canary smoke tests: model-load OK, auth OK, latency within SLO. No 5xx observed.
sam: promotion unpaused. initiating prod promotion at 18:12 UTC.
maya: adding to release notes: reason for hold + rotation steps + rollback commands.
sam: release notes updated and changelog entry created. Promotion successful at 18:18 UTC.
kyle: follow-up: add automated parity gate to pre-promote checklist to compare `alias/*` versions across envs.
nina: :thumbsup:
